newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Eleven killed in Colombian bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Eleven killed in Colombian bus crash.

text.p: Eleven people died and more than 50 were injured when an overcrowded bus collided head on with a truck on Colombia's Caribbean coast, authorities said on Friday.

Police said most of the victims were returning home from work in the port city of Barranquilla when the bus, which had swerved out of its lane to avoid a pothole, slammed into the tractor trailer truck laden with iron rods on Thursday evening.
The bus was packed far beyond capacity because it had picked up passengers from a broken down passenger bus just minutes before the accident, police said.
Ten of the injured were listed in critical condition in Barranquilla hospitals early on Friday.
A total of 6,158 people died in traffic accidents across Colombia in 1996.
